responsibility: Declares analyzer-specific selftest entry points and shared test helpers used across the gcc/analyzer module under CHECKING_P builds. It exposes the central run_analyzer_selftests dispatcher, a helper for constructing synthetic global VAR_DECLs, and the per-source-family test functions that let individual analyzer components register self-contained unit tests.
same_name_distinction: Collects declarations for analyzer selftest helpers and per-source test entry points under CHECKING_P. Unlike analyzer-selftests.cc, it does not run tests itself; it is the shared declaration point that other analyzer sources include.
